questions.question: Which conference featured the paper titled “Retrieval‑Enhanced Machine Learning” in 2022?
questions.explanation: The paper was published in the Proceedings of the 45th International ACM SIGIR Conference in 2022 (Source Page: [6])

questions.question: Who is NOT listed as an author of the 2022 “Retrieval‑Enhanced Machine Learning” paper?
questions.explanation: The authors are Hamed Zamani, Fernando Diaz, Mostafa Dehghani, Donald Metzler, and Michael Bendersky; Jun’ichi Tsujii is an editor of a different volume (Source Page: [6])

questions.question: The 2024 paper “Stochastic RAG” focuses on which primary technique?
questions.explanation: The title indicates the method is “End‑to‑End Retrieval‑Augmented Generation through Expected Utility Maximization” (Source Page: [6])

questions.question: Which dataset is NOT part of the KILT benchmark used for evaluation in the context?
questions.explanation: The listed KILT datasets are NQ, TriviaQA, HotpotQA, FEVER, and WoW; SQuAD is not mentioned (Source Page: [2])

questions.question: For which reason did the authors use the validation set instead of the test set?

options.A: The test set is too large.
options.B: The test set lacks publicly available ground‑truth labels.
options.C: Validation set has higher quality annotations.
options.D: Test set is reserved for future competitions.

questions.explanation: The text states ground‑truth labels are unavailable for the test set, so the validation set is used (Source Page: [2])

questions.question: Which organization published the proceedings of the SIGIR ’22 conference?
questions.explanation: The proceedings are published by the Association for Computing Machinery, New York, NY, USA (Source Page: [6])

questions.question: The DOI “10.18653/v1/D18-1259” is associated with which conference’s proceedings?
questions.explanation: The DOI appears after the citation of the “Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing” (EMNLP) volume (Source Page: [6])

questions.question: Which of the following is a correct pairing of a dataset and its corresponding reference number in the context?
questions.explanation: The text lists TriviaQA with reference [13] (Source Page: [2])

questions.question: What does the acronym “RAG” stand for in the 2024 paper title?
questions.explanation: The title expands to “Retrieval‑Augmented Generation” (Source Page: [6])

questions.question: Which benchmark aggregates the datasets Natural Questions, TriviaQA, HotpotQA, FEVER, and Wizard of Wikipedia?
questions.explanation: These datasets are taken from the KILT benchmark (Source Page: [2])
